findings.summary: Traceability assigns design-workflow-signing-request-schema-drift and historical-plan-cancellation-blocks-current-withdrawal to the existing approval/lifecycle repair slice, but the design's Slice B findings and implementation boundary do not identify them or specify their acceptance. Reconcile the scope and ownership across the package.

The design says the additional-scope addendum contains the activation/topology/uninstall slice table, acceptance matrix, engineering questions, and architecture alignment; Spec §18 relies on an associated addendum for implementation sequence and exclusive ownership. This conflicts with treating the five-source package as complete and the addendum as non-normative scratch, leaving scope details and choices unavailable for this review.
